data_provenance_attestation.upstream_manifest_note: Local normalized Parquet datasets are gitignored and have no pre-existing independent checksum manifest in main; artifacts/g2_data_provenance.parquet only records 12/7808 raw monthly rows as checksum_verified=true. Accordingly, local files without an external trusted manifest are reported as HASH_RECORDED_UNVERIFIED rather than authentic.

MAKER_FEE_MULTIPLIER_2X.description: Multiplies only modeled maker entry/exit fees by 2x. Does NOT double spread, slippage, market impact, queue uncertainty, partial fills, borrow financing, or liquidation costs.

FULL_EXECUTION_FRICTION_STRESS_2X.description: Would require doubling all measured/calibrated execution friction terms (maker/taker fees, spread, slippage, market impact, queue-miss cost, partial-fill cost, borrow, and liquidation cost).

friction_terms.calibration_basis: Binance VIP0 (10.0 bps spot / 2.0 bps perp); Hyperliquid Tier-0 (4.0 bps spot / 1.5 bps perp).
friction_terms.limitation: Tiered fee rebates or VIP changes are not dynamically modeled.

friction_terms.calibration_basis: Binance 5.0 bps perp taker; Hyperliquid 4.5 bps perp taker.
friction_terms.limitation: Not multiplied by cost_multiplier in borrow_liquidation_model; emergency_taker_fee_bps is applied only inside liquidation_penalty_cost when liquidation_triggered is True.

friction_terms.calibration_basis: Historical continuous L1/L2 spread series unavailable; Hyperliquid L1 snapshot has only n=19 observations.
friction_terms.limitation: Cannot calibrate historical bid/ask spread across 2021-2026 regime changes.

friction_terms.calibration_basis: No historical execution fill log or L2 order-book depth replay.
No empirical order-flow impact calibration on target venues.
friction_terms.limitation: Square-root impact is uncalibrated for Hyperliquid spot/perp books.

friction_terms.calibration_basis: Assumed fifo_fill_probability=0.55; Hyperliquid L1 sample size n=19 (<1000 minimum observations).
friction_terms.limitation: Queue-fill calibration from n=19 L1 observations is statistically insufficient without an independent statistical justification.
Modeled structurally in double-entry journal, not empirically calibrated.

friction_terms.calibration_basis: Deterministic adverse-move liquidation breach scenario (19.5% adverse jump on delayed hedge at 20.0% initial margin vs 1.00% HL MMR).
friction_terms.limitation: Probability of single-leg miss during volatility spikes is assumed, not measured.

friction_terms.calibration_basis: Parametric 5% APR and 10% APR stress scenarios.
friction_terms.limitation: Actual venue borrow rates spike non-linearly during high positive funding regimes.

friction_terms.calibration_basis: Historical 8h Binance and 1h Hyperliquid funding rate time series.
friction_terms.limitation: Local Parquet provenance is HASH_RECORDED_UNVERIFIED without external trusted manifest.

friction_terms.calibration_basis: Modeled maintenance margin ratios (0.50% Binance / 1.00% HL) and 50.0 bps liquidation penalty plus emergency taker fee.
friction_terms.limitation: Insurance-fund / ADL / cascade slippage beyond nominal penalty is uncalibrated.

multiple_testing_lineage.family_selection_bias_note: H3_BASIS_CARRY_V2 is registered with trial_seq=1 for its fresh prospective window, but inherits family-level selection bias from 185 prior research trials. Unadjusted single-test p-values do not control FWER/FDR.

dimension_audit.observed_strategy_treatment: Signal-filtered subset of perp/spot carry pairs with regime gating.
dimension_audit.null_control_treatment: Unconditioned equal-weight average across all available carry pairs on each sampled day.
dimension_audit.impact_on_p_value: Null mixes instruments not held by the strategy, altering cross-sectional variance.

dimension_audit.observed_strategy_treatment: Multi-day persistent carry positions held across consecutive positive-funding regimes.
dimension_audit.null_control_treatment: Independent single-day draws without replacement (no contiguous holding-period blocks).
dimension_audit.impact_on_p_value: Destroys multi-day holding structure and serial carry clustering.

dimension_audit.observed_strategy_treatment: Explicit entry/exit turnover driven by signal transitions.
dimension_audit.null_control_treatment: Zero turnover modeling on sampled daily returns.
dimension_audit.impact_on_p_value: Null is not penalized for random entry/exit churn.

dimension_audit.observed_strategy_treatment: Observed H3_MAKER Sharpe is net of modeled maker fees.
dimension_audit.null_control_treatment: Null samples gross equal-weight carry returns with zero entry/exit fees.
dimension_audit.impact_on_p_value: Asymmetric fee treatment prevents apples-to-apples Sharpe comparison.

dimension_audit.observed_strategy_treatment: Historical H3_MAKER omitted spot borrow financing (V2 adds 5%/10% APR borrow).
dimension_audit.null_control_treatment: Zero borrow financing applied in null control.
dimension_audit.impact_on_p_value: Cannot validate V2 alpha under positive borrow costs.

dimension_audit.observed_strategy_treatment: Daily summed 8h Binance funding accrual on short perp leg.
dimension_audit.null_control_treatment: Same daily summed funding series used to construct carry_ret.
Uniform equal-weight across all pairs regardless of funding rank.
dimension_audit.impact_on_p_value: Tests combined selection + timing vs unconditioned universe rather than pure timing null.

dimension_audit.observed_strategy_treatment: 1019 active days out of 2130 total days.
dimension_audit.null_control_treatment: Draws exactly n_active=1019 days per permutation.

dimension_audit.observed_strategy_treatment: Annualized Sharpe over full calendar equity curve where build_positions_maker (p_fill=0.55) scales gross exposure below 1.0 during partial-fill entry/exit ramps.
dimension_audit.null_control_treatment: Annualized Sharpe over full zero-padded calendar vector applying full 1.0 unit equal-weight gross exposure on every sampled active day.
dimension_audit.impact_on_p_value: Time-varying partial-fill exposure vs full-unit exposure changes return variance and drawdown scaling across active days, preventing strict risk-normalized parity.

dimension_audit.null_control_treatment: i.i.d. day sampling without block bootstrap or stationary bootstrap.
dimension_audit.impact_on_p_value: Understates variance of null Sharpe under positive funding autocorrelation.
